description: Contract for the observation interface: one measured readout.

fields.name: obs_id
fields.description: Immutable record ID of the observation.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Immutable source_id of the linked Source record.

fields.name: assay
fields.description: Full assay definition (normalized name plus definition).

fields.name: denominator
fields.description: Experimental-unit count, or the evidence state when not an integer.

fields.name: time_point
fields.description: Stage or follow-up window of the measurement.

fields.name: sample_linkage
fields.description: Sample-linkage ID of the samples the measurement came from.

fields.name: evidence_locator
fields.description: Figure, table, panel or section that carries the measurement.
